top_choice_rationale: The incretin chain is complete and mature: Holst on GLP-1 physiology, Mojsov on the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) form, and Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide biology and receptor pharmacology. Replicated randomized programmes show glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal benefit. A discovery-focused citation with the 'made possible' clause keeps the prize on the hormone and its physiology without crediting the laureates with drug development. The three-name allocation omits Knudsen, which is a real attribution cost, but it does not outweigh the merit, so I prefer P001 to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented connection to Drucker, Holst or Mojsov
